metadata.title: yCAPTCHA
metadata.description: Your community's inside-joke CAPTCHA — upload your own images and build challenges around shared references instead of traffic lights.

landing.tagline: Stop picking traffic lights. Pick your own images, audios, and challenges.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Three steps. One page of code.
landing.step1Body: Drag a folder into the dashboard, or fork one of the sample sets. Mark the images that count as correct.
landing.step2Body: Drop one script tag and one div into your page. Tie it to a puzzle with your site key.
landing.step3Body: POST the token and your secret key to /api/v0/captcha/siteverify.
landing.ctaSub: Drop in the widget, pick your images, ship.
landing.faqA1: Not really. yCAPTCHA has no ML, no fingerprinting, no behavioral analysis — any bot with off-the-shelf image recognition will walk straight through it. If you need real bot protection, use Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha. yCAPTCHA is for the vibe: your community, your puzzles.
landing.faqQ2: Can I use my own images?
landing.faqA2: That's the whole point. Upload your images, mark which images are correct, and your CAPTCHA becomes an inside joke only your community gets — subway lines, rhythm game charts, dev tools, niche memes.
landing.faqA4: No, but you can self-host it.
landing.faqA5: Yes. 200 MB upload cap per account, no paid tier, no credit card.
